intent_reference.summary: Runtime Native Live Closure v3 — Explicit Technical Explain & 8-Host End-to-End Proof (owner artifact 2026-08-24)

intent.outcome: Source, native installation, profile behavior (technical_explain), context/skills/handoff, review/quality and evidence all bound to one current HEAD with 8/8 native live closure and honest gates.
in_scope: kernel resolver and CLI projection for 8 hosts (no persistent mode)
lifecycle quality and Review A/B contracts
acceptance gates and honest status reporting
non_goals: no Review B during default execution
no global MCP or hand-edit of generated/

requirements.summary: technical-explain naming and v3 contract (field technical_explain, no technical_mode)
default vibe and activation only on explicit owner request with many variants
canonical profile + kernel + CLI updated to technical_explain, 8 overlays regenerated, no legacy refs
native materialization chain and NATIVE_LIVE definition (8 checks) and deactivate semantics
8-host native live closure receipts bind HEAD with required fields, STALE if old commit
single canonical contract for prompt/context/skills/handoff with 56-dim matrix and 4-layer skill proof
lifecycle quality gates and Review A (bounded) / Review B (OFF) contracts, host-role symmetry
model-neutral dogfood via canonical flow, honest NEEDS_USER/BLOCKED if capability missing
implementor executes in one pass without per-step approval, no Review B, max one Review A correction, separated evidence reporting

decisions.statement: technical_explain is request-scoped explanation depth, not execution mode.
decisions.rationale: Prevents persistent mode drift and keeps verification/scope/security unchanged.

decisions.statement: Single canonical profile source projected to 8 hosts; overlays are SYNCED only when bytes equal source.
decisions.rationale: Eliminates manual drift and stale readback.

decisions.statement: Deactivation removes exactly the managed overlay section, preserves user config, and stale overlay fails closed.
decisions.rationale: Satisfies native surface ownership and readback honesty.
